account_policy.applies_when: installed only; absent stays UNSET and per-call ctx limits still apply

approvals.detail: server-validated, stored, revocable; verification fails closed on mismatch/expiry/revocation

native_protection.detail: conservative: nothing offered until vendor documents the exact combination and the account is verified eligible

ownership.detail: per-intent orderId ownership + native-workflow overlap block; fresh processes refuse new entry until recover_open() + reconcile_all() (RECOVERY_REQUIRED)

recovery.gate: RECOVERY_REQUIRED when durable nonterminal rows exist but the registry is empty
